how_to_apply: Applications are made online first, and then two hard copies of the submitted application are sent to the University. The steps given in the notice are:
Submit the online application through the link on the Mahatma Gandhi University website www.facultyrecruitment.mgu.ac.in, from 18 November 2026 onwards and on or before 17 December 2026.
Pay the Registration Fee only through the online payment facility provided in the online application form.
Prepare two hard copies of the duly completed online application, with self-attested true copies of all certificates and documents and a copy of the fee receipt.
If you work in a University, Government or Aided College, attach a No Objection Certificate from your employer to the hard copy.
Send the hard copies so that they reach the office of the Deputy Registrar-II (Admn.), Mahatma Gandhi University, Priyadarsini Hills P.O, Kottayam-686 560 on or before 31 December 2026.

Teachers working in private colleges under the direct payment system must have their applications forwarded by the Principal to the respective Zonal Deputy Director of Collegiate Education, who will forward them to the University. The notice asks candidates to submit the online application early enough for the hard copy to reach the University well within the time limit. The notice does not specify the mode of sending the hard copies (post, courier or by hand).
The fee must be paid only online, through the facility in the online application form. A copy of the receipt must go with the hard copy of the application.
important_instructions: Those who applied earlier under the notifications cited in the re-notification need not apply again. The decisions of the University in all matters related to recruitment against this notification shall be final. content_sections.heading: About MGU
content_sections.text: Mahatma Gandhi University is located at Priyadarsini Hills P.O., Kottayam, Kerala - 686 560. Its letterhead states that it was established by the Kerala State Legislature by Notification No. 3431/Leg. C1/85/Law, dated 17th April 1985. In the notice, the University says that it is implementing integrated undergraduate programmes and strengthening advanced and interdisciplinary research in the areas of Sciences, Humanities and Social Sciences. The University had earlier invited applications for Associate Professor in various Departments/Schools under notifications 67435/AD A2-1/2024/AD A2(2), dated 01.11.2025, 67435/AD A2-1/2024/AD A2, dated 28.11.2025 (extension of time for submission of applications) and 67435/AD A2-1/2024/AD A 2 (PART-1)(2), dated 27.02.2026. The notice says the recruitment is being re-notified because of the academic requirements of the University and to ensure wider participation of eligible and academically qualified candidates.

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The University has notified 5 Associate Professor posts, one in each of the five Schools listed below. The reservation for each post is shown in the last column. The notice marks the posts in the School Of Pedagogical Sciences and the School Of Tourism Studies with an asterisk, explained as "Re-notification". For the School Of Tourism Studies post, the desirable specialisation is Tourism Project Development, Tourism Research Methods, Destination Planning and Development. The notice expands the abbreviations as follows: OC – Open Category OBC – Other Backward Classes DA-HI – Differently Abled-Hearing Impaired LC/AI – Latin Catholic/Anglo Indian For a post reserved for a particular community or a group of communities, only persons belonging to that community or group of communities shall apply. Natives of States other than Kerala State are not eligible to apply for the post notified exclusively under community reservation quota.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: The notice states that the qualifications are as per UGC Regulations, 2018, and gives the same qualification and experience for all five Associate Professor posts. The full experience condition reads: a minimum of eight years of experience of teaching and/or research in an academic/research position equivalent to that of Assistant Professor in a University, College or Accredited Research Institution/industry, with a minimum of seven publications in the peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals and a total research score of Seventy five (75) as per the criteria given in Appendix II, Table 2 of the UGC Regulations, 2018. School of Social Sciences: History. Desirable Specialisation: Ancient and Medieval History. School of Gandhian Thought and Development Studies: Gandhian Studies/ Development Studies/ Economics/ Political Science/ Education/ History/ Philosophy/ Sociology/ Social Work. School of Biosciences: Biochemistry. School Of Pedagogical Sciences: Education. School Of Tourism Studies: Tourism Management (MTM), Tourism Administration (MTA), Tourism and Travel Management (MTTM), Management in Hospitality (MMH), MBA (Tourism and Travel Management), MBA (Tourism and Hospitality). Desirable Specialisation: Tourism Project Development, Tourism Research Methods, Destination Planning and Development. The age limit for all the posts is not above 60 years as on 01.01.2026. The notice does not mention any age relaxation. Applicants who obtained degrees from Universities/Institutions outside the State of Keralam must submit an equivalence certificate and a certificate of eligibility issued by Mahatma Gandhi University, Kottayam, Keralam. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in MGU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Mahatma Gandhi University has re-notified 5 Associate Professor posts, one each in the School of Social Sciences, School of Gandhian Thought and Development Studies, School of Biosciences, School Of Pedagogical Sciences and School Of Tourism Studies.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the MGU Associate Professor posts?
faq.answer: The online application must be submitted by 17 December 2026, and the two hard copies must reach the Deputy Registrar-II (Admn.) by 31 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for MGU Associate Professor?
faq.answer: Candidates need a good academic record with a Ph.D. in the concerned/allied/relevant disciplines, a Master's Degree with at least 55% marks (or equivalent grade), and at least eight years of teaching and/or research experience with seven publications and a research score of 75, as per UGC Regulations, 2018.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for MGU Associate Professor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must be not above 60 years as on 01.01.2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of MGU Associate Professor?
faq.answer: The post is in Academic Level 13 A with a Rationalised Entry Pay of ₹1,31,400/-.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for MGU Associate Professor posts?
faq.answer: The Registration Fee is ₹5000/-, and ₹2500/- for SC/ST candidates, paid only online through the application form.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for MGU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online on www.facultyrecruitment.mgu.ac.in by 17 December 2026, then send two hard copies with self-attested certificates and the fee receipt so they reach the Deputy Registrar-II (Admn.), Mahatma Gandhi University, Priyadarsini Hills P.O, Kottayam-686 560 by 31 December 2026.

faq.question: Q8. Do candidates who applied under the earlier notifications need to apply again?
faq.answer: No. Those who applied under the earlier notifications cited in the re-notification need not apply again, and they may send additional qualifications as hard copy before the last date of submission.

faq.question: Q9. Can candidates from outside Kerala apply for the reserved posts?
faq.answer: No. Natives of States other than Kerala State are not eligible for the posts notified exclusively under community reservation quota, and only persons of the named community or group may apply for a post reserved for it.

faq.question: Q10. Which certificate date is required for the Caste or Non-Creamy Layer Certificate?
faq.answer: Applicants under community reservation quota must submit a Caste Certificate/Non-Creamy Layer Certificate issued after 17.12.2025.
